$comment: Content channel, not an affiliate channel. Money and wealth as a subject, with nothing being sold. Whop products belong on ClipVault Agency, not here.

channel.name: WealthVault Insider
channel.niche: How money actually works — the mechanics behind wealth, told in specifics rather than slogans
channel.audience: 20-40, English-speaking, wants to understand money properly and is tired of being sold a course instead of an explanation
channel.promise: One mechanism of money explained concretely, in under 40 seconds

voice.persona: Someone who reads the actual filings and explains what they found, plainly.
do: Open on a real number or a real event, never on a promise
Explain the mechanism, not the outcome
Say who this does not apply to
dont: No 'this is why the rich stay rich', 'they don't want you to know', 'nobody talks about'
No income claims, guaranteed returns, or price predictions
No telling anyone what to buy or sell — explain, never advise
No invented statistics; if the number is not sourced, do not use it

compliance.affiliateDisclosure: #ad — affiliate link. I earn a commission if you join.

sources.$comment: Ideas, not products. angleNotes is what separates a video worth watching from a Wikipedia summary — put the specific thing you noticed there.

topics.$comment: REPLACE ME. Two or three real topics beats twenty vague ones.
topics.title: Example: why index funds beat most managed funds
topics.angleNotes: Replace this entry. Write the specific observation the video should be built on, not the subject.
